parties.respondent: Jarnail Singh (Now Deceased) Through Its LRs & Ors.

summary: Specific performance decree execution; balance sale consideration deposit; legal heir's locus standi; executing court's order setting aside by High Court reversed; decree holder's right to execute upheld; delay in deposit not fatal without default clause; acquiescence to execution; objection to maintainability dismissed; High Court's interference in revision erroneous; Executing Court's direction reinstated.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court's order setting aside execution set aside; Executing Court's order directing deposit of balance sale consideration and execution of sale deed restored.
